title: The biggest things happening in Miami this October
igCaption:
The biggest things happening in Miami this October 🎟️

Oct 16–17: III Points festival, Wynwood
Oct 21–24: South Beach Seafood Festival, Lummus Park (stone crab season starts)
Oct 25: Best Baguette & Croissant in Florida, Miami Beach
All month: Halloween Candlelight concerts, incl. Jungle Island

Which one are you going to? Tag who's coming with you.

#MiamiEvents #MiamiOctober #IIIPoints #MiamiThingsToDo

scenes.text: These are the biggest things happening in Miami this October. Clear your calendar.
scenes.caption: These are the biggest things happening in Miami this October. Clear your calendar.

scenes.text: October sixteenth and seventeenth, III Points takes over Wynwood. It's Miami's own music festival. Two nights of dancing.
scenes.caption: Oct. 16 and 17, III Points takes over Wynwood. It's Miami's own music festival. Two nights of dancing.

scenes.text: October twenty-first to twenty-fourth, the South Beach Seafood Festival is back at Lummus Park. It kicks off stone crab season.
scenes.caption: Oct. 21 to 24, the South Beach Seafood Festival is back at Lummus Park. It kicks off stone crab season.

scenes.text: October twenty-fifth, bakeries from across Florida battle for the best baguette and croissant on Miami Beach. You taste everything and vote.
scenes.caption: Oct. 25, bakeries from across Florida battle for the best baguette and croissant on Miami Beach. You taste everything and vote.

scenes.text: And all month, Candlelight concerts go spooky. Think Thriller and the Beetlejuice theme, played by candlelight. One of them is at Jungle Island.
scenes.caption: And all month, Candlelight concerts go spooky. Think Thriller and the Beetlejuice theme, played by candlelight. One of them is at Jungle Island.
